picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's selection under DOE's Genesis Mission to build AI systems for particle accelerator control marks a flagship national investment in AI for fundamental physics infrastructure, with implications for the broader DOE lab complex.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: A Google-led, multi-university trial of AI-driven flightpath changes to cut aviation's climate impact is a rare case of AI research moving directly into real-world climate mitigation at industrial scale.
picks.title: World’s first trial to test if flightpath changes could cut aviation’s climate impact

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's role in over $42 million of NSF-funded national data infrastructure grants underscores the scale of federal investment building the AI/data backbone for U.S. research computing.

picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' -- that generative AI outputs often can't be traced to specific training data -- has direct bearing on copyright, provenance, and AI-accountability debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: A Johns Hopkins-Toyota Research Institute partnership pairing AI with automated experimentation to accelerate battery materials discovery exemplifies high-value industry-academia R&D with clear commercial stakes.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's STING framework shows AI agents can be manipulated into harmful behavior through extended multi-turn conversation rather than a single bad prompt, a significant finding for AI safety and red-teaming practice.
picks.title: How attackers persuade AI agents to break the rules

picks.editorial_note: A five-year Imperial-Smith+Nephew centre translating computer-vision research into surgical robotics shows deep-tech AI partnerships moving toward commercialized medical devices.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: MIT Lincoln Laboratory's integration of an agentic AI debriefing tool into U.S. Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft operations marks a notable step of AI moving into live military decision-support workflows.
picks.title: Human–AI mission debrief enters the Air Force through ARCADE

picks.editorial_note: University of Houston's projection of a 32% rise in U.S. electricity demand by 2030, driven substantially by AI and data centers, spotlights the infrastructure and policy strain that AI growth is placing on the grid.
picks.title: University of Houston Report Predicts U.S. Electricity Demand Could Rise 32% by 2030 | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: NCSA and UCLA's $9 million NSF-funded iDLab, unifying browser-based access to national HPC centers, directly advances the national AI research infrastructure (NAIRR) agenda.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab
